mentions.text:
Interesting $LAZR holds a lot of names I've been writing about for a year.

Top three are $LITE at 15.18%, $AXTI at 10.14% and Aixtron $AIXA at 9.50%. Positioning themselves across different points of the photonics supply chain. Lumentum makes the InP lasers, AXT makes the substrate they get grown on, Aixtron makes the dominant MOCVD machine for making InP lasers

The other photonics ETFs I've looked at are heavy transceivers and heavy China. Both bother me, honestly. NVIDIA put Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics into full production August 13, so its inevitable that CPO slowly starts taking share from pluggables from here, and the FCC rule on Chinese transceivers Reuters reported August 4 is still out there.

A lot of the upstream InP names just aren't US listed, which makes it hard for retail to get exposure. 43.6% of this fund is foreign holdings. $SOI, $IQE and Sivers were three of my best longs earlier this year and you need IBKR for all of them.

Agree with @ParadisLabs here. Not a bad way to track the whole photonics chain under one ticker.
